title: WebSocket ticket
description: LITE-1a C5. `POST /v1/ws-ticket {"path": ...}` answers one ticket for one WebSocket path: `/v1/events`, `/v1/agent/default/chat/events` or `/v1/herdr/panes/{pane}/observe|control` (a web credential cannot ask for `control`). The browser opens `wss://<host><path>?ticket=<ticket>` with no Authorization header; the daemon spends the ticket on arrival, so it works once, for `expires_in` seconds, and only on that path. A spent, expired or foreign ticket is `401 ws_ticket_invalid`.
